changelog: Rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.4 on Media-Serv (lsheardo-12.4 branch) from upstream 1.7.5, plus our fixes (1.7.5.1): the index.html file patch honours Jellyfin's Base URL; a cross-household sign-out forgets its entry only after the device is signed out; device merges never rewrite another household's device lists; a skipped PIN no longer refills the shared PIN allowance; a clashing rename is refused before the picture is saved. Upstream 1.7.2-1.7.5: Roku PIN-bypass fix and further security fixes.
description: Adds multi-user profile switching to Jellyfin. A single account can have up to five isolated profiles — each with its own watch history, parental controls, and library access.
name: Bonfire
